unknown_or_condition: Keep all objects and papers safe

action: Wipe the empty desktop with the cloth
done_when: Surface is dry and has no visible dust

action: Put every loose paper into File or Review
done_when: Every loose paper is inside one folder
unknown_or_condition: Discard none; processing Review is outside scope

done_when: Stand is in its intended position

action: Test whether the existing charger reaches without tension
done_when: Actual reach result has been observed and recorded
unknown_or_condition: If it does not reach, leave unresolved; buy nothing

action: Coil the loose cable with existing reusable ties
done_when: No cable crosses the writing area
unknown_or_condition: After confirming cable position; unresolved reach is not solved by assumption

done_when: Notebook is in place with usable writing room
Open notebook page is evenly visible and laptop area stays clear

final_review: All four approved objects (lamp, notebook, pen cup, laptop stand) are in place, and nothing else is on the desktop.
